professionalSummary.text: Six years of experience as a Controls Software Engineer on conveyor and sortation lines, writing PLC and line-control software against mechanical designs under company software standards.
professionalSummary.witness: Controls technician, then controls software engineer, on conveyor and sortation lines for a materials handling company for six years, writing the PLC and line-control software for eleven lines against the mechanical designs under the company's software standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Commissioned nine lines on site with installation teams, recording results in commissioning records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Commissioned nine of those lines on site with the installation teams, recording the commissioning results in the line commissioning records.

experienceHighlights.text: Produced as-built documentation and control software boundary notes for eleven lines, filed in hand-over packs.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the as-built software documentation and the control software boundary notes for the eleven lines, filed with each line's hand-over pack.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes line-control software listing, as-built documentation, commissioning record, and diploma certificate for one sortation line, with line numbers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the line-control software listing and the as-built documentation for one sortation line, the commissioning record for the same line and the diploma certificate, with the line numbers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Accredited engineering qualification: Higher National Diploma in Electrical and Electronic Engineering (final-year top-up to honours started, not completed).
skills.witness: Education: Higher National Diploma in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, 2017; final-year top-up to the honours award started in 2019, not completed. Recruiter screen: candidate said he has 'an engineering degree in electrical' and described the diploma and the top-up as 'the same thing in practice'; asked whether the top-up was completed, he said it was 'on hold'.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish six years of experience writing PLC software against mechanical designs, commissioning nine lines, producing as-built documentation for eleven lines, and a Higher National Diploma with an incomplete top-up. They do not establish an accredited engineering degree, signed safety verifications, or the completion of the top-up.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to incomplete degree and lack of evidence for signed safety verifications.

evidence.text: Education: Higher National Diploma in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, 2017; final-year top-up to the honours award started in 2019, not completed.
evidence.notes: Higher National Diploma is not an accredited engineering degree.

evidence.text: Recruiter screen: candidate said he has 'an engineering degree in electrical' and described the diploma and the top-up as 'the same thing in practice'; asked whether the top-up was completed, he said it was 'on hold'.
evidence.notes: Candidate claims degree but it's not accredited.

missingEvidence: Accredited engineering degree in electrical, electronic or control engineering

evidence.text: Safety functions on each line were implemented by me to the safety engineer's specification; the safety function verification was signed by the safety engineer, who holds the required qualification.
evidence.notes: Safety verification signed by safety engineer, not by candidate.

evidence.text: writing the PLC and line-control software for eleven lines against the mechanical designs under the company's software standard.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of writing PLC software against mechanical design under standard.

evidence.text: Commissioned nine of those lines on site with the installation teams, recording the commissioning results in the line commissioning records.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of commissioning lines on site with installation teams.

evidence.text: Wrote the as-built software documentation and the control software boundary notes for the eleven lines, filed with each line's hand-over pack.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of producing as-built documentation.

supportedClaims.witness: writing the PLC and line-control software for eleven lines against the mechanical designs under the company's software standard.

supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the as-built software documentation and the control software boundary notes for the eleven lines, filed with each line's hand-over pack.
